answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 8884 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it allowed to pay Zakat to a well to do person, who has lost his house, wealth and other belongings in Earthquake of October 29th 2008. Question: Is it allowed to pay Zakat to a well to do person, who has lost his house, wealth and other belongings in Earthquake of October 29th 2008. Answer ID: 8884 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1113/1113=M/1429) If he lost his wealth and belongings due to earthquake and does not own wealth equal to nisab then he can receive the zakah amount provided he is not from syed family. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
